changelog: MOBILE FIXES. The desktop pass in 0.0.40 had been firing on phones: a phone held in landscape is 2340px wide, so gating those rules on width alone was never a desktop test and every one of them applied on mobile. The Daily Commission text overflowed its plate, the battle HUD was zoomed up, and a Fullscreen toggle appeared on a device that is already fullscreen. NOMAD'S TOP BAR was a separate bug: the momentum drive meter was never counted when the bar divides up its width, so BREAK CAMP was clipped off the end. PLAY. BOARD CHIP TIERS TRACK THE RUN AGAIN — dying in the first few nodes of Act 1 at Ascension 0 was still rolling 10% rare and 2.3% epic, better than one run in eight handing out a rare-or-better for losing early; a shallow run is now common and uncommon only, while the top tiers still arrive for a deep or high-ascension run. LOSING THE REFUGEE NO LONGER SAYS YOUR HQ WAS DESTROYED — the escort failure never set the defeat text so it fell back to the HQ message while the HQ was still standing, and a Last Stand running out had the same gap. CARD UPGRADES AND REMOVALS NOW SHOW EVERY CARD CHANGED: Field Forge and Master Armory upgrade TWO cards and the reveal only ever showed one. They appear as real card faces with their upgraded art, side by side. DESKTOP. The hand's card view matches the collection's scale — it had been rendering about a third smaller. The Key puts Counters across the top with everything it explains below in two columns.
